provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: [L43-L56] (HIGH/ignored configuration) BMI initialize converts the supplied configuration-file path but never uses it, so initialization silently reads the library's default input rather than the requested file.
audit_member_text: [L43-L56] (HIGH/api-contract) initialize converts the caller-supplied configuration path into configfile but never uses it, so the BMI configuration argument has no effect on model initialization.

base_member_text: [L146-L153] (MED/null pointer handling) set_current_time converts and dereferences the incoming C pointer without checking for C_NULL_PTR.
audit_member_text: [L141-L154] (MED/ffi/pointer-contract) set_current_time converts and dereferences an arbitrary incoming c_ptr without checking c_associated, so a null pointer from the C caller is invalid.

base_member_text: [L99-L114,L132-L135] (MED/undefined query output) Unknown variable names cause get_var_type and get_var_rank to return without initializing their output arguments or providing an error status.
audit_member_text: [L88-L114] (MED/uninitialized-output) get_var_type returns without setting c_type_name when chartoindex fails and also converts an uninitialized type_name for an unexpected type code.
[L118-L136] (MED/uninitialized-output) get_var_rank returns without assigning the output rank when the requested variable name is unknown.

base_member_text: [L178-L188] (MED/getter side effect) get_time_step invokes compute_dt with fresh local counters instead of merely returning an established step, so a query can mutate timestep state and may differ across repeated calls.
audit_member_text: [L178-L189] (MED/query-side-effect) The nominal get_time_step query calls compute_dt on live model state before returning par%dt, so its read-only BMI contract is unclear and repeated queries may alter timestep-related state.

base_member_text: [L67-L77] (HIGH/lost error status) update overwrites the executestep return code with outputext's return code, allowing a failed model step to be reported as successful.
audit_member_text: [L61-L77] (HIGH/error-propagation) update overwrites the executestep return code with outputext's return code unconditionally, masking a failed timestep whenever outputext returns success.

base_member_text: [L150-L167,L178-L189,L195-L199] (HIGH/inconsistent time units) With morfacopt enabled, current and end time are exposed in morphology-scaled time while get_time_step returns unscaled par%dt and update accepts its dt without inverse scaling, violating a single BMI time-unit contract.

audit_member_text: [L138-L140] (HIGH/build-completeness) The module includes get_var_shape.inc, get_var.inc, and set_var.inc, but none is present anywhere under source_code, leaving the BMI variable API dependent on missing generated artifacts.

[L150-L166,L195-L199] (LOW/time-scaling-contract) Morphological time conversion silently substitutes 1 for any morfac below 1, making set/get time behavior diverge from the configured factor without reporting invalid configuration.
